title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
summary: A mysterious millionaire throws lavish parties on Long Island while chasing a lost love, exposing the hollow glitter of the American Dream.

author: George Orwell
summary: In a totalitarian future, Winston Smith tries to keep a private thought alive under the gaze of Big Brother and the Party.

title: To Kill a Mockingbird
author: Harper Lee
summary: Scout Finch watches her father defend a Black man in a racist Southern town, and learns what courage and empathy look like.

title: The Catcher in the Rye
author: J.D. Salinger
summary: Holden Caulfield wanders New York after leaving school, angry at adult hypocrisy and desperate to protect what still feels innocent.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
summary: Elizabeth Bennet clashes with the proud Mr. Darcy, until both have to rethink first impressions, class, and what they really want.

title: The Hobbit
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
summary: Comfortable hobbit Bilbo Baggins joins dwarves on a quest for dragon gold and discovers more bravery than he thought he had.

title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
author: Gabriel García Márquez
summary: The Buendía family lives through generations of love, war, and magic in the town of Macondo, where time seems to fold in on itself.

title: The Handmaid's Tale
author: Margaret Atwood
summary: Offred is forced into reproductive servitude in Gilead, a theocratic regime, and clings to memory as a form of resistance.

title: Beloved
author: Toni Morrison
summary: After escaping slavery, Sethe is haunted by the ghost of her child and by a past that will not stay buried.

title: The Name of the Wind
author: Patrick Rothfuss
summary: Kvothe, a legendary magician in hiding, tells how a gifted boy became a myth: music, university, and a search for the Chandrian.
